Frozen updater activation exec seam captured the converge handoff; it did not execute a staged real application binary.
Drained external process inventory was simulated with a disposable ps fixture because real owner-native processes were deliberately left running.
Existing converge Rule0 treats a free daemon lock as converged and leaves daemon startup to the next owner invocation.
This proves safe refusal/compatible rollback and an offline retry path; it does not claim frozen v0.20 automatically drains detached workers.
